issue.title: Symbolic link in new_http_archive causes error

labels.name: P2
labels.description: We'll consider working on this in future. (Assignee optional)

repository.name: bazel
repository.description: a fast, scalable, multi-language and extensible build system

issue.body:
This error occurs in 0.3.2 but not 0.3.1.

Here's an example that triggers it:

```
    new_http_archive(
      name = "music21",
      build_file = "music21.BUILD",
      url = "https://github.com/cuthbertLab/music21/releases/download/v3.0.3-alpha/music21-3.0.3.tar.gz",
      sha256 = "4c0cc1e1fa3638c53ecf45ec13301174114dcf59f93faffc6586c5b94ae065e3",
      strip_prefix = "music21-3.0.3/music21",
    )
```

When building, the following error occurs:

> File "LICENSE" linked from "LICENSE" does not exist and referenced by '//path/to:target'.

There are "LICENSE" symlinks in both music21-3.0.3 and music21-3.0.3/music21; presumably this has something to do with the error.

body: Yeah, https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/b4060b6e53944a7c3bdc5e62b288e7293a87652a/src/main/java/com/google/devtools/build/lib/bazel/repository/ZipDecompressor.java#L129-L132 disallows all up-level references.  This is a bit harsh, we could allow symlinks that don't travel up past the root dir.

Just hit this bug as well because of test fixture (replicating `/proc`). 

If you are pulling from github you can quickly work around this by switching from grabbing a zip to grabbing a tarball:
```diff
- url = "https://github.com/<user>/<repo>/archive/<commit>.zip",
- type = "zip",
+ url = "https://github.com/<user>/<repo>/archive/<commit>.tar.gz",
+ type = "tar.gz",
```

suggested fix: https://bazel-review.googlesource.com/c/bazel/+/34352

Fixes Bazel error when a WORKSPACE imports
https://github.com/grpc/grpc/archive/master.zip:

"Zip entries cannot refer to files outside of their directory:
master.zip has a symlink to ../../../tools/distrib/python_wrapper.sh"
